background_story: Amaia, a young and ambitious historian, had always been fascinated by the grandeur of 18th-century Europe. Her academic pursuits led her to Potsdam, Germany, where she spent a summer researching the city's rich history. As she wandered through the stunning palaces and gardens of the Sanssouci Park, Amaia became captivated by the story of Frederick the Great, who once ruled Prussia from this very spot. Her research focused on the cultural and artistic achievements of the era, and she spent hours pouring over ancient texts and manuscripts in the Potsdam archives. Amaia's time in Potsdam not only deepened her understanding of European history but also inspired her to write a novel set in the city during the Enlightenment. Her experiences in Potsdam had a profound impact on her life's work, shaping her into a renowned expert in her field.
